templateNote: One short concept: one frame with three cards. More frames would fragment nine sentences.

frames.title: Idempotency keys
frames.purpose: Holds the whole concept: what a key is, how the server uses it, its limits and an example.
frames.rationale: All nine sentences are about one mechanism; splitting them would separate the limits from the claim they limit.
frames.expansion: None expected; the frame stays small.

elements.content: An idempotency key is a unique value that lets the server recognise a retry
The server returns the stored result for a completed key — only within 24 hours, and never for a different amount
elements.layout: Beside or below the definition; the limits are part of this card, not separate cards.

elements.content: Example: a dropped checkout response retried with key 7f3c-91ab is charged once
Retries are safe within a bounded window — not a general guarantee
elements.outsideFrameReason: Shown as the frame's own takeaway line (group.content.takeaway) under its title, not as a card inside it.

relationships.explanation: The example illustrates the replay mechanism.
The key is what the server looks up to decide whether to replay.

hierarchy.reason: The example illustrates the concept and must not read as a second main idea.
